"''As you wish.|Shin Hati and Marrok|}} The '''RP82 Fiend fighter''' or simply the '''RP82''' was a model of compact, high-performance assault [[starfighter]]. ==History== {{Quote|Our fighters have engaged the target and pursued them into the debris field.|[[Enoch]]|}} [[File:RP82FiendFighter-CGSWG.png|thumb|left|300px|A modified version of the RP82]] Modified RP82s were [[pilot]]ed by [[Shin Hati]] and [[Marrok]] as [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] under the pay of [[Morgan Elsbeth]].{{Databank|shin-hati-s-fiend-fighter|Shin Hati's Fiend fighter}} Meanwhile, Elsbeth's [[scout guard]]s flew standard RP82s, which were, comparatively, a smaller starfighter via a smaller wing design. Marrok, Hati, and the scout guards used their Fiend fighters when [[Dogfight in the Denab system|engaging]] former [[Jedi]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] and her [[Mandalorian]] Jedi apprentice [[Sabine Wren]] during their investigation of the [[planet]] [[Seatos]] where the secret ''[[Eye of Sion]]'' was located. After Elsbeth and her forces found [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] "Thrawn," the scout guards and their starfighters joined the ranks of his [[Thrawn's forces|remnant]]. ==Characteristics== [[File:PartThree-TimeToFly.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Shin Hati in the cockpit of her Fiend fighter]] Compact, high-performance, and agile, RP82 Fiend fighters were starfighters specially contracted for bursts of high-performance. Their basic simple design ensured ultimate manoeuvrability, including a [[cockpit]] with a cylindrical fuselage and forward-mounted wings. ==Armament== The starfighter was equipped with a laser cannon mounted onto the fuselage. ==Behind the scenes== This starfighter was first pictured in the teaser trailer for ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'' in [[April 7]], [[2023]],{{SWYouTube|HnzNZ0Mdx4I|Ahsoka | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/ahsoka-teaser-trailer}} before making their debut in the third episode of [[Ahsoka Season 1|''Ahsoka'' Season 1]], "[[Part Three: Time to Fly]]," on [[August 29]], 2023.{{Twitter|starwars|status/1692552080764887366|Star Wars|quote=.Thank you to all the fans who celebrated with us at our @AhsokaOfficial fan events around the world last night! We're excited to announce that new episodes of #Ahsoka will now launch Tuesdays at 6PM PT, starting with our two-episode premiere on August 22, only on @DisneyPlus.|archivedate=20230818152836}} It was first identified in a [[LEGO]] [[LEGO Star Wars|Star Wars]] set as part of the Summer 2023 wave in the [[Wikipedia:San Diego Comic-Con|San Diego Comic Con]] in [[July 19]] of the same year.{{WebCite|url=https://www.thebrickfan.com/lego-star-wars-sets-announced-at-sdcc-2023|text=LEGO Star Wars Sets Announced at SDCC 2023|author=Allen "Tormentalous" Tran|date=2023-07-19|archivedate=20230720001156}} The box art for the LEGO set depicts Shin Hait's Fiend fighter, controlled by the dark side adept herself, in a dogfight against a New Republic [[E-wing starfighter]] piloted by [[Captain]] [[Porter (New Republic)|Porter]]. Other promotional imagery for the set depicts Hati piloting the craft overhead while Morgan Elsbeth and Baylan Skoll deal with Porter and a [[R-series]] [[astromech droid]].{{LEGOCite|num=75364|name=New Republic E-Wing vs. Shin Hati's Starfighter}} ==Appearances== *{{Ahsoka|Part Three: Time to Fly}} {{1st}} *[[Ahsoka 3|''Ahsoka'' 3]] *{{Ahsoka|Part Seven: Dreams and Madness}} *[[Ahsoka 7|''Ahsoka'' 7]] ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|HnzNZ0Mdx4I|Ahsoka | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/ahsoka-teaser-trailer}} {{1stp}} *{{LEGOCite|num=75364|name=New Republic E-Wing vs. Shin Hati's Starfighter}} *''[[Weird But True!
